# Aim

The sensitivity analysis (S5 in the paper) varies two features of the
selection factor B, keeping everything else as in the main analysis:

- \(\beta_B\), the prognostic effect of B (log-HR);
- \(\rho_{B,TS}\), the latent correlation between B and tumour size, which
  determines how much information on the unobserved B can be recovered by
  matching on an observed covariate.

For each cell of the grid this document calibrates the Weibull DGP, generates
a superpopulation, builds the registry and the trial pool exactly as in
`analysis/main/02_generate_populations.R` (scenario S2: trial restricted to
B = 1, B unobserved), and computes the true estimands with the same function.

**Shared with the main analysis:** DGP functions (`R/dgp_weibull.R`), all
covariate distributions and coefficients other than \(\beta_B\) and
\(\rho_{B,TS}\) (S1 sheet of the workbook), censoring, population sizes,
calibration targets, treatment effect \(\beta_Z\) (fixed at the value
calibrated in the main analysis), registry / trial split, true estimands (`compute_truth_superpop()`, defined in
`analysis/main/02_generate_populations.R`).

**Per cell:** \(\lambda_0\) and \(k\) are recalibrated, so that every cell
has the same marginal control median and \(S_0(12)\) in the superpopulation.
The random seed is reset at the start of each cell: cells share the same
random numbers and differ only in \(\beta_B\) and \(\rho_{B,TS}\).

**Control cell:** the main-analysis values (\(\beta_B\) and \(\rho_{B,TS}\)
of the workbook) are added to the grid. Its superpopulation and registry are
identical to those of the main analysis, and its true estimands match those
of S2 up to the sampling of the trial pool.

Inputs: `config/parameters.R`, `config/simulation_structure.xlsx`,
`data/dgp_calibration.rda` (from `01_dgp_weibull.Rmd`).
Outputs: `data/superpop_results_sensitivity.rda`,
`data/truth_sensitivity.rda`, `results/tables/tableS5_cells.csv`.


# Setup

```{r libraries}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(survival)
library(knitr)

source(here("config/parameters.R"))
source(here("functions/dgp_weibull.R"))


dir.create(here("results/tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

read_row <- function(sheet, row) {
  readxl::read_excel(here(PATH_DGP_XLSX), sheet = sheet) |>
    dplyr::filter(parameters == row)
}

reg_params   <- read_row("S1", "registry") |> check_dgp_params()
trial_params <- read_row("S1", "trial")
dgp_args     <- make_dgp_args(reg_params)

# Treatment effect calibrated in the main analysis
load(here("data/dgp_calibration.rda"))
beta_Z <- cal$beta_treatment_OS

# Arguments of each DGP function
cov_args_names <- intersect(names(dgp_args), names(formals(generate_covariates)))
lp_args_names  <- intersect(names(dgp_args), names(formals(compute_lp_OS)))
```


# Grid

```{r grid}
cells <- tidyr::expand_grid(beta_B = BETA_B_SENS, rho_B_TS = RHO_B_TS_SENS) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    tibble::tibble(beta_B = reg_params$beta_B_OS, rho_B_TS = reg_params$rho_B_TS)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    scenario = paste0("betaB_", beta_B, "_rho_", rho_B_TS),
    control  = dplyr::row_number() == dplyr::n()
  )

cells |> kable()
```


# Calibration, superpopulations, pools and true estimands

For each cell: calibration of \(\lambda_0\) and \(k\) on a calibration
population, superpopulation in the same random stream, then (after resetting
the seed) the registry / trial split and the S2-type trial pool, as in the
main analysis.

```{r cells}
calibration <- vector("list", nrow(cells))
pools       <- vector("list", nrow(cells))
truth       <- vector("list", nrow(cells))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(cells))) {

  args <- dgp_args
  args$beta_B_OS <- cells$beta_B[i]
  args$rho_B_TS  <- cells$rho_B_TS[i]

  # -- Calibration of lambda0 and k (beta_Z fixed) ---------------------------
  set.seed(SEED_MASTER)

  calib_pop <- do.call(generate_covariates, c(list(N = N_CALIB_MAIN), args[cov_args_names]))
  lp0       <- do.call(compute_lp_OS,       c(list(dat = calib_pop),   args[lp_args_names]))
  ctrl      <- calibrate_weibull_control(lp0, TARGET_MEDIAN_Z0, TARGET_S0_TAU, TAU)

  calibration[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
    lambda0           = ctrl$lambda0,
    weibull_shape     = ctrl$shape,
    beta_treatment_OS = beta_Z,
    median_z0_check   = weibull_median_marginal(lp0, ctrl$lambda0, ctrl$shape),
    S0_tau_check      = weibull_survival_marginal(TAU, lp0, ctrl$lambda0, ctrl$shape),
    median_z1_check   = weibull_median_marginal(lp0 + beta_Z, ctrl$lambda0, ctrl$shape),
    S1_tau_check      = weibull_survival_marginal(TAU, lp0 + beta_Z, ctrl$lambda0, ctrl$shape),
    objective         = ctrl$objective
  )

  # -- Superpopulation (same random stream as the calibration) ---------------
  superpop <- do.call(
    generate_superpopulation,
    c(
      list(
        N                 = N_SUPERPOP_MAIN,
        C_low             = C_low,
        C_upp             = C_upp,
        lambda0           = ctrl$lambda0,
        weibull_shape     = ctrl$shape,
        beta_treatment_OS = beta_Z
      ),
      args
    )
  )
  if (cells$control[i]) superpop_control <- superpop

  # -- Registry and trial pool, as in 02_generate_populations.R --------------
  set.seed(SEED_MASTER)

  ind <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), nrow(superpop), replace = TRUE,
                prob = c(P_REGISTRY_SPLIT, 1 - P_REGISTRY_SPLIT))

  registry_pool <- superpop[ind, ] |>
    mutate(time = time_z0, event = event_z0, S = 0)

  trial_pool <- superpop[!ind, ] |>
    filter(B == 1) |>
    mutate(time = time_z1, event = event_z1, S = 1) |>
    slice_sample(n = N_TRIAL_POOL, replace = FALSE)

  checks <- tibble::tibble(
    p_B_registry       = mean(registry_pool$B),
    cor_B_tumor_size   = cor(registry_pool$B, registry_pool$tumor_size),
    S0_tau_registry    = mean(registry_pool$T_true_z0 > TAU),
    S0_tau_trial       = mean(trial_pool$T_true_z0 > TAU),
    median_z0_registry = median(registry_pool$T_true_z0),
    median_z0_trial    = median(trial_pool$T_true_z0)
  )

  pools[[i]] <- list(registry_pool = registry_pool, trial_pool = trial_pool, checks = checks)

  # -- True estimands --------------------------------------------------------
  truth[[i]] <- compute_truth_superpop(registry_pool, trial_pool, COVS_SCORE_MAIN, TAU)

  message(sprintf("[%s] cell %d/%d: %s", format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"),
                  i, nrow(cells), cells$scenario[i]))
}

rm(superpop, calib_pop, lp0)
```


# Results

## Calibration and cell diagnostics

```{r results}
superpop_results <- cells |>
  dplyr::bind_cols(dplyr::bind_rows(calibration)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(superpop_obj = pools)

truth_sensitivity <- cells |>
  dplyr::select(scenario, beta_B, rho_B_TS) |>
  dplyr::bind_cols(dplyr::bind_rows(truth))

tab_cells <- superpop_results |>
  dplyr::select(-superpop_obj) |>
  dplyr::bind_cols(dplyr::bind_rows(purrr::map(pools, "checks"))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(benchmark_error_S_tau = S0_tau_registry - S0_tau_trial)

tab_cells |>
  dplyr::select(beta_B, rho_B_TS, control, lambda0, weibull_shape,
                median_z0_check, S0_tau_check, median_z1_check, S1_tau_check,
                p_B_registry, cor_B_tumor_size,
                S0_tau_registry, S0_tau_trial, benchmark_error_S_tau) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```

`benchmark_error_S_tau` is the difference between the latent \(S_0(12)\) of
the registry and that of the trial target population: the registry selection
error that matching has to remove.



# Save

```{r save}
save(superpop_results,  file = here("data/superpop_results_sensitivity.rda"))
save(truth_sensitivity, file = here("data/truth_sensitivity.rda"))

write.csv(tab_cells, here("results/tables/tableS5_cells.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
